host_mode: C89 pedantic-errors, Wall, Wextra, Werror, AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer
leak_sanitizer: Disabled only because ptrace is incompatible; candidates and harnesses do not allocate heap memory. Address/UB checks remain active.
limits: Pointer-containing 28-byte sample/12-byte registry and F78/F7C context layouts are native 32-bit IDO evidence, not host sizeof. Pointer-free range and 4088-byte record layouts are also host checked. Valid registered record membership, allocated payload offsets and finite live linked/sentinel lists are required. Helpers are explicit synthetic contracts, not reconstructed native implementations. No malformed-data, runtime-game or cartridge claim.
